title: Autonomous locality investigation of insulin electronic correlations
difficulty_reasons: The agent must generate and discriminate a finite but researcher-chosen space of fragment/overlap designs, justify candidate coverage and selection, and validate correlation conclusions without an author-route hint.

paper.title: Divide and correlate: mapping electronic correlations in proteins via local cut-wise reconstruction

data.description: Self-contained original experimental PDB 3I40 and system, contact, MI-definition and comparison-radius specification.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable candidate investigation, validation, conclusions report.
